Quick-Commerce Order & Inventory (Zepto)

Ten-minute grocery delivery lives or dies on one number: how many cartons of milk this dark store can still promise. This case study builds the order and inventory core that Zepto, Flipkart (Minutes), Walmart and Meesho ask about: reserve stock when the order is created, deduct it when payment succeeds, release it on cancel, payment failure or timeout, pick the nearest dark store that has the whole basket, and do all of it with 20 shoppers racing for the last 5 units without overselling or deadlocking.
